content: .{@-त्रम्@} [गां भूमिं त्रायते त्रै-क] .²1 a cow-pen. .²2 a stable in general. .²3 a family, race, lineage; गोत्रेण माठरोऽस्मि <ls>Sk.</ls>; so कौशिकगोत्राः, वसिष्ठगोत्राः <ab>&c.</ab>; <ls>Ms. 3. 109</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 141</ls>. .²4 a name, appellation; जगाद गोत्रस्खलिते च का न तम् <ls>N. 1. 30</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6. 5</ls>; see ˚स्खलित below; मद्गोत्राङ्कं विरचितपदं गेयमुद्गातुकामा <ls>Me. 88</ls>. .²5 a multitude. .²6 increase. .²7 a forest. .²8 a field. .²9 a road. .²10 possessions, wealth. .²11 an umbrella, a parasol. .²12 knowledge of futurity. .²13 a genus, class, species. .²14 a caste, tribe, caste according to families. . ({@-त्रः@}) a mountain; ‘गोत्रं नाम्नि कुलेऽप्यद्रौ’ इति यादवः; <ls>Śi. 9. 80</ls>. Hence गोत्रोद्दलनः means Indra; <ab>cf.</ab> इन्द्रे तु गोत्रोद्दलनः कुलघ्ने गिरिदारणे <ls>Nm.</ls> ({@-त्रा@}) .²1 a multitude of cows. .²2 the earth. {@˚उच्चारः@} recitation of family pedigree. .{@˚कर्तृ, -कारिन्@} {%m.%} the founder of a family. {@˚कीला@} the earth. {@˚ज@} {%a.%} born in the same family, gentile, a relation; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 7. 24</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 135</ls>. {@˚पटः@} a genealogical table, pedigree. {@˚प्रवरः@} the oldest member or founder of a family.
